scope: Local source build only; no inherited or new third-party binary redistribution approval

upstream.transport: Real Git objects, complete fixed tree coverage and git fsck; no generated replacement source

main_dependency_repair.verification: Default Go SumDB and readonly exact module locks

retained_input.purpose: Thirteen exact plugin backends, signed frontend/plugin assets and unchanged base payload; old approval is not a security verdict for the new runtime

busybox_repair.basis: Validate actual HTTP request target and proxy Host before connection, including relative redirect target; retain percent-encoded paths
busybox_repair.runtime_dependency: Only the retained target musl; utmps and skalibs are statically linked with their ISC notices
